decision.observation: Monday the 8th, 9:30 p.m.; the farmer is on the vertical cobblestone path beside the fountain square, with the route south open.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing south will reach the southern east–west town road; from there, the untested eastbound cobblestones may lead across the river toward the beach.
decision.memory: Objective: meet Willy at the beach south of Pelican Town to receive his item. The journal's 5:00 p.m. time has passed. Avoid the wooded southern exit and grass below the eastbound road. Funds are 268g.
